name: What kind of damage can sewage backup cause to my bathroom?

mainEntity.name: What kind of damage can sewage backup cause to my bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sewage backup can cause extensive damage to your bathroom. This includes contamination of porous materials like drywall, flooring (especially carpet or wood), and insulation, which often need to be removed and replaced. It can also damage fixtures, cabinets, and personal items. Beyond visible damage, the moisture can lead to severe mold growth within 24-48 hours, and the unsanitary conditions pose significant health hazards from bacteria and viruses.
acceptedAnswer.description: Sewage backup contaminates porous materials, damages fixtures, and leads to rapid mold growth and serious health hazards in your bathroom.
